description: Recursively enumerate files in ~/Documentos_Teste, ~/Documentos, ~/Downloads, ~/Imagens, /mnt filtering for extensions .xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .txt, .csv, .jpg, .png, .db, .backup, .psd, .zip, .rar. Uses nftw() or opendir/readdir. Returns a linked list of full paths.
name: scan_directories
